items.exampleEn: It took three years for the shop to make a profit.
items.exampleZh: 這家店花了三年才開始獲利。

items.exampleEn: If the painting interests you, make an offer.
items.exampleZh: 如果你對這幅畫有興趣，就出個價吧。

items.exampleEn: Working late to meet a deadline is common in this office.
items.exampleZh: 在這間辦公室，為了趕上截止期限而加班很常見。

items.exampleEn: The new phone is out of stock everywhere.
items.exampleZh: 那款新手機到處都缺貨。

items.exampleEn: To place an order, click the green button.
items.exampleZh: 要下訂單，請按綠色的按鈕。

items.exampleEn: Luck played a role in winning the game.
items.exampleZh: 運氣在這場比賽的勝利中扮演了一個角色。

items.exampleEn: We need more programs that raise awareness of recycling.
items.exampleZh: 我們需要更多提高回收意識的活動。

items.sentenceEn: The blue shirt is out of stock in my size.
items.sentenceZh: 那件藍色襯衫我的尺寸缺貨了。

items.audioEn: We have to meet a deadline on Friday, so nobody can leave early this week.
items.audioZh: 我們星期五得趕上一個截止期限，所以這週沒有人能提早下班。
items.questionZh: 這週為什麼沒有人能提早下班？
options: The boss is visiting the office

items.sentenceEn: Teachers play a role in shaping young minds.
items.sentenceZh: 老師在塑造年輕人的想法上扮演一定的角色。

items.sentenceEn: The festival hopes to raise awareness of local farms.
items.sentenceZh: 這個節慶希望提高大家對在地農場的關注。

items.stemEn: The school's charity fair ____ of eight thousand dollars this year.
items.stemZh: 學校的義賣園遊會今年獲利八千元。

items.stemEn: I'd like to ____ for twenty boxes of paper.
items.stemZh: 我想下訂單買二十箱紙。

items.passageEn: Kim runs a small online shop that sells bags she makes by hand. Last month, a famous singer posted a photo with one of her bags, and within two days every bag was out of stock. A large store even made an offer to sell her bags in all its branches. Kim was excited, but she was worried she could not make enough bags in time. In the end, she hired two helpers and said yes. She also uses her shop's page to raise awareness of fair pay for people who make things by hand.
items.passageZh: Kim 經營一家小網路商店，賣她親手做的包包。上個月，一位有名的歌手貼出一張拿著她包包的照片，不到兩天，所有包包都缺貨了。一家大型商店甚至提議在所有分店販售她的包包。Kim 很興奮，但擔心自己沒辦法及時做出足夠的包包。最後，她請了兩位幫手，答應了這個提議。她也利用商店頁面，提高大家對手工製作者應得合理報酬的意識。

questions.questionZh: Kim 的包包為什麼兩天內就賣光了？
options: 她在網路上辦了抽獎活動

questions.questionZh: Kim 最後怎麼解決做不出足夠包包的問題？
options: 拒絕了大型商店的提議

items.promptZh: 我昨天在網路上訂了一台新的印表機。
referenceEn: I placed an order for a new printer online yesterday.
Yesterday I placed an order online for a new printer.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「下訂單」（例如 placed an order for a new printer 等）
不用片語但意思正確的說法也算對（例如 ordered a new printer online、bought a new printer online 等）
有「昨天」，用過去式（例如 placed 等）
「在網路上」可寫，例如 online 等，位置不限

items.promptZh: 他們出了一個比較低的價格，想買我們的車。
referenceEn: They made an offer to buy our car at a lower price.
They made an offer for our car at a lower price.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「出價」（例如 made an offer for our car 等）
不用片語但意思正確的說法也算對（例如 offered to buy our car for less 等）
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 made、have made 等）
「比較低的價格」可寫，例如 at a lower price、for less money 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 審題員 issue 結案：干擾項 raise an order 在英式商業英文中是實際存在的搭配（raise a (purchase) order for ...，指開立採購單），I'd like to raise an order for twenty boxes of paper 並非明顯錯誤；建議換成 make an order 以外更不可能成立的動詞（例如 put an order／take an order 以外的明確錯誤搭配），避免歧義。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 已修正：干擾項 raise an order（英式商業英文可指開立採購單）換成 keep an order

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 審題員 issue 結案：參考答案 They made an offer for our car, but the price was lower. 與中文題目「出價想用比較低的價格買我們的車」意思不符：but the price was lower 沒說比什麼低、也把「想用較低價格買」改成轉折敘述，英文本身也語意不完整；建議改為 They made an offer for our car at a lower price. 之類。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 已修正：參考答案改為 "They made an offer for our car at a lower price."，對上「想用比較低的價格買」
